input.evidence: Phase-5 Evidence[] only, no raw tool_results, no retrieved_context

hard_rules: evidence_ids must exactly match a supplied Evidence.evidence_id
citation numbers are never model-assigned, only compiled deterministically post-generation
no chain-of-thought field anywhere in output objects
source appendix built only from Evidence.source_metadata/source_url, never LLM-authored bibliography

abstention_policy.zero_evidence: abstained=True, exactly one ABSTENTION claim, zero FACTUAL claims, zero citations
abstention_policy.insufficient_evidence: FACTUAL claims only for what Evidence supports plus one ABSTENTION claim naming the gap

conflict_policy: both sides cited, conflict_detected=True, qualification language required, no averaged middle claim
source_grouping_policy: reference-level grouping by source_record_id; evidence-level distinctness preserved internally via grouped_evidence_ids
